meta.name: RealAnglesey
meta.description: Anglesey Circuit (Trac Mon), International (3.30 km) and Coastal (2.47 km) layouts from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Welsh Government / NRW LIDAR composite DTM (1 m). Open, windswept coastal headland with the sea on three sides and Snowdonia to the east.
